senses.gloss: f. (v. כְּלוּב) box, consisting of movable tenoned links.
units: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 1 כ׳ של חייטין the tailors’ box.—Pesik. Ănokhi, p. 138ᵃ ונתנום בכ׳ and put them (the Cherubs of the Temple) in a box; a. e.—Esp. coffin with bier.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 27a">M. Kat. 27ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>ועניים בכ׳</he> (not <he>בכליכה</he>) and the poor were carried out on a common bier; opp. <cite ref="D01041"><he>דרגש</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:16">Tosef. Nidd. IX, 16</cite> <he>בכְלִיבָא</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12:9">Par. XII, 9</cite> <he>קרן של כ׳</he> the movable support of the bier, Maim.; (oth. opin.: the ring for keeping the corpse in position).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Lam. R. to III, 16</cite> <cite ref="K00721"><he>כליבא</he></cite>.
